scope: Node preservation follow-up only. Two native GitHub-hosted Ubuntu24.04 cron fixtures, AMD64 and ARM64; not a rerun of the earlier nine-case base matrix.

findings.issue: Mutable manager-cache race during executable probes
findings.fix: Authenticate root-private immutable active cache copies before exposing them to non-root offline probes; recheck current cache without executing it.

Use a separate framed, no-follow per-entry/per-file SHA256 digest for new preservation evidence and authenticated archive comparison. Historical TreeDigest and runtime/rollback contracts remain unchanged; its old value is never sufficient for new enrollment.

findings.issue: Project cache growth falsely invalidates healthy manager proof
findings.fix: Bind only active pinned pnpm/Yarn cache entries and lastKnownGood metadata; historical/project caches retained.

audit.disposition: Fixed locally with focused regressions; no repeated broad audit or independent recheck claimed.

behavior: Ordinary panel updates with an existing selected Node component use guarded --preserve, including remembered choices and explicit --node. They never invoke prerequisite repair, abandoned-snapshot restoration, registry metadata lookup, npm install, Corepack manager preparation or the inner install rollback snapshot.
Fresh/additional Node installation and the existing explicitly chosen node-toolchain install command retain full setup/repair, original lifecycle/lease/runtime admission, snapshots and rollback.

Absent optimization evidence is not a defect. Non-mutating authenticated comparison uses trusted signed Node archive identities and exact pinned official Corepack/pnpm/Yarn/Bun artifacts; only then is protected optimization evidence saved. Version strings or installed flags do not authenticate payloads.

Reuse validates current selection/pins/trust profile, protected state, exact command links and ownership, framed content digests and actual executable usability. Mutable active manager caches are copied privately, authenticated, made immutable and probed as fluxo; current selected cache contents are rechecked afterward. Unrelated project cache growth is excluded from the proof.

Missing, tampered, unsafe, incompatible or interrupted state produces actionable refusal. The proof is not runtime-update/activation authority; no approval, version major, lease, hold, schema, journal or live rollback reference is changed.

The outer panel/toolchain rollback snapshot remains. Historical TreeDigest, approved runtime records and live legacy readers/helpers remain compatible; new preservation evidence never relies solely on the historical digest.

focused_validation.ui: Both exact native builds build embedded UI first; local UI and documentation build passed.
focused_validation.authentication_tests: Pinned digest before parsing; archive path/link/size limits, official-origin restrictions, current defaults and command metadata; tampered/missing payload, ownership/link errors, absent/invalid/mismatched proof, pin/selection changes, interruptions, immutable cache and unrelated cache growth. Unit/mocked cases are not additional native provider coverage.
